01 — About

Who I am

Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh

I am a first-year BBA DBE student at IIM Bangalore, with a background in Diploma Engineering (CME) from Aditya University, Andhra Pradesh. My journey has taken me from engineering fundamentals to the world of digital business and entrepreneurship.

I enjoy figuring out how things work — whether it is a business model, a financial decision, or an operational process. I am curious, analytical, and always looking for ways to connect technology with real-world business problems.
